gaps: Division land leaders: not fully confirmed. Everything here comes from all 324 releases in PulteGroup's own newsroom (2020-09 to 2026-11), the FY2025 10-K, the corporate management page, and a few association and event pages; local business journals, conference lists and most HBA boards were not checked.

Area structure: company releases name four Area Presidents (North, Southeast, Central, West). Which divisions sit in which area is not published; reporting lines marked Inferred rest on geography or on who announced an appointment. Whether a separate Florida area still exists is not public (McCormick was 'Florida area president' in 2022-2023 and is 'Southeast Area President' in 2025-2026).
New England division (MA, RI): division president not named in any company release; only Ashton Khoury, Vice President of Sales, New England Division (company release, 2025-08-13).

Pacific Northwest division (Seattle; Portland/Vancouver): no current leader found. Last named: Graham Epperson, Pacific Northwest Division President (company release, 2022-08-24); too old to list as current.
Minnesota / Minneapolis division: no current leader found. Last named: Jaime Tharp, president of the Minnesota division (company release, 2020-09-28); too old to list as current.
New Mexico (Albuquerque / Santa Fe): no leader found; in 2021 one division president covered New Mexico and Colorado (Les Anderson), since replaced in Colorado.
Charlotte, Coastal Carolinas, Southeast Florida: only 2023 names found (listed as Inferred). Arizona and San Antonio: last company confirmation Jan 2024 and Nov 2024 (listed as Inferred).
Raleigh: Jeff Davis is published only as 'Division President' on a Raleigh-area community release; the division name is inferred.

Division land leaders: only two are named in 2025-2026 company releases (Houston, Georgia). Leads too old to list: Glenn Nier, Vice President of Land, Colorado division (2022-04-25 release). Land heads for the other ~25 divisions: not found in the sources reachable without search.

Brand presidents: PulteGroup's brands (Pulte Homes, Centex, Del Webb, DiVosta, John Wieland, Explore by Del Webb) are run through the geographic divisions; no separate brand presidents are published. Sean Strickler (West Florida) is the named 'brand champion' for Explore by Del Webb.
Las Vegas: SNHBA's 2026 board lists two Pulte Group people without job titles (Wayne Newmiller, Brandon Laughter); titles not confirmed.

Business Wire copies of PulteGroup releases would not load (blocked / rate-limited); the company newsroom copies were used instead. The April 2024 Colorado release is missing from the newsroom and was read through a syndicated copy.

Newsroom date caution: one migrated release ('PulteGroup Enters Greenville, South Carolina Market') carries a 2026-03-08 date but its text is from 2023; it was not used as a 2026 source. Other release dates were checked against years mentioned in the text.
